scientific_integrity: All central conclusions rest on a complete analytic proof. Computational tests are finite diagnostics, not proofs of asymptotic or universal statements. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The proof treats one-complex-dimensional Gaussian Fock Toeplitz annuli at fixed critical physical radial thickness and growing rank; fixed a<b, c>0. No noncircular or non-Gaussian universality, uniform small-width or large-width limit, or independent publication-priority certification is claimed.
title: Critical-width Gaussian annuli have a two-edge Fock concentration spectrum
